original_test_intent: Read current DCMI DHCP activation, discovery configuration and DHCP timing parameters through the in-band BMC interface and preserve a structured baseline.
original_method: Issue local raw 0x2c 0x13 0xdc <selector> 0 separately for selectors 0x01-0x05, retain each response and decode it against the approved DCMI layout.
manual_activity: No hands-on action is required; the project provides the target and expected policy, and the end user owns the final verdict.
required_inputs: Verified DUT/BMC and local IPMI interface
safety_requirements: Do not invoke the adjacent 0x12 setter
Validate completion, selector, revision and response length
agent_execution_scope: Compare with policy without changing state
engineer_actions: Decide PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED from the evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The aggregate CLI output may omit revision or per-selector bytes and its remote SSH wrapper does not prove local raw execution.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run local raw 0x2c 0x13 0xdc <selector> 0 once for each selector 0x01-0x05, validate completion and structure, then decode the current value.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The in-band route, group-extension byte, selector set, trailing zero and 10/5 timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a selector-aware local reader that retains raw bytes and exports explicit supported, unsupported, malformed and transport-failure states.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces success-only acceptance with field-level validation and removes unrelated evidence deletion.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: This read does not authorize a setter and does not cover the remote OOB transport.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Management configuration may be sensitive, and flattened output can hide revision-specific or unsupported values even though the command exits successfully.

project_override_considerations: A high-level getter can supplement but not silently replace the raw selector matrix unless equivalence and all per-selector fields are proven.
expected_evidence: Completion, revision, length and reserved-field checks
Decoded configuration baseline and policy comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master item, 0x13 get opcode, selector list and read-only action agree. Its weak success criterion and log-clear boilerplate are deficiencies, not contradictory source semantics; the DeepSeek route mismatch is outside the Master source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read command and selector family are explicit. Decoder and expected values are ordinary project inputs, so no irreducible blocker exists.

review_improvement: Preserves the exact local raw selector coverage and turns it into a deterministic, non-mutating DCMI configuration snapshot.
independent_technical_reasoning: These selectors carry different types and lengths, so one aggregate exit code cannot demonstrate correct retrieval. Separate raw reads permit the runner to bind each payload to its requested selector, validate revision and length, and report unsupported values without ever crossing into the neighboring write operation.
